sources.title: GPT-4.1 Mini model documentation
sources.evidence: Exact-model documentation gives ID gpt-4.1-mini, default snapshot gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14, 1,047,576-token context, text and image inputs, text output, file uploads and function calling. It explicitly describes operation without a reasoning step and marks the model deprecated. It discloses no parameter count or architecture. Fresh October 27 parameter recheck of the exact model page again found no total or active count; smaller/faster is a qualitative description, not an explicit same-size base-model lineage.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-4.1 in the API
sources.evidence: Dated April 14, 2025; explicitly launches GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 mini and GPT-4.1 nano in the API that day. Groups mini within the GPT-4.1 family and supplies mini-specific vision and function-calling benchmark columns. The article calls mini a small model but supplies no parameter count or architecture. Reopened for the October 27 parameter re-audit: the mini-specific performance, latency and pricing comparisons do not supply a nominal total or active count or a named same-size base.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: PDF file input for vision-capable models is processed into extracted text and page images. Responses and Chat Completions accept PDFs; this is an API file format, not a separate learned modality. Read with the exact mini model page confirming image input and file uploads.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: The current agreement, effective January 1, 2026, covers API services, grants limited access and use, and reserves service IP rights. Supports the descriptive proprietary classification, not a named checkpoint license or the claim that these exact terms applied at April 2025 launch.

sources.title: Introducing gpt-oss
sources.evidence: Complete indexed primary article dated August 5, 2025 states that gpt-oss were OpenAI’s first open-weight language models since GPT-2, corroborating closed weights for the April 2025 mini release. Direct page retrieval timed out and urllib returned 403; the indexed article was readable. Its numerical counts and Transformer/MoE architecture describe gpt-oss only and are not transferred.

sources.title: OpenAI deprecations
sources.evidence: October 14, 2026 notice lists GPT-4.1 mini (gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14) for January 14, 2027 API shutdown. This documents service lifecycle; it does not change the first-release date or establish endpoint operation through a live request.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh original PDF fetched October 27, 2026 and full text searched; Introduction/Table 1 and Model Data and Training inspected. The comparison names GPT-4.1-nano and later text mentions GPT-4.1, but no GPT-4.1 mini total or active count is supplied. Successor naming and GPT-5 system descriptions do not establish mini specifications.

sources.title: Models.dev GPT-4.1 mini record
sources.evidence: Baseline lead reviewed: it labels the family gpt-mini and includes the promotional description and PDF input. Its specifications are independently checked against the exact OpenAI model documentation; this catalog is not primary verification.

sources.title: Training Agents to Self-Report Misbehavior
sources.publisher: Bruce W. Lee, Yueh-Han Chen and Tomek Korbak; linked by OpenAI Alignment
sources.evidence: Fresh full original HTML fetched October 27, 2026; model setup, conservative training setup and Appendix J.9 training-data tables inspected. GPT-4.1 mini is trained through OpenAI’s public fine-tuning API, but neither its total nor active parameter count is given. Appendix table quantities are trajectory pairs, samples and tokens, not model weights. Prompted scratchpad usage is separate from dedicated internal reasoning-mode support.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity (v2)
sources.evidence: Original July 5, 2026 revision reopened October 27; Sections 6.3 and 7.5 and Appendix E/Table 15 checked in full original HTML and PDF text. The exact gpt-4.1-mini row has dashes for Params, IKP Pred. and Arch. The paper calibrates effective knowledge capacity against open-model sizes; its prediction bands are not nominal deployed model counts. It supplies no mini active-count convention or developer-confirmed base lineage.

sources.title: Amity Sigma Thinking v3r model card: performance comparison
sources.evidence: Original model-team card reopened October 27, 2026. Its Tau2-Bench comparison lists GPT-4.1-mini with Size ~8-20B, but supplies no attribution or measurement method for that range and no total-versus-active definition. References cover Amity training and task benchmarks, not an OpenAI count disclosure. Rejected as an unattributed size estimate, not accepted as a nominal benchmark active-count convention.

name.note: Retain official launch styling; current documentation capitalizes Mini. This record is the unpinned API name, whose documented target is the April 14, 2025 snapshot.

developer.note: The official announcement and model documentation identify OpenAI.

family.note: The announcement explicitly places mini in the GPT-4.1 family; gpt-mini groups variants across generations and is not the release family.

release_date.note: Explicit first API launch date for mini; later ChatGPT availability and current deprecation do not replace the first release.

open_weights.note: Mini is released as a hosted OpenAI API model; the later first-open-weights-since-GPT-2 statement corroborates that the April 2025 release did not distribute weights.

license.note: Descriptive proprietary service/model classification. No public downloadable-checkpoint license is claimed.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit found no mini-specific nominal total count or explicit lineage to a base with a published count in exact OpenAI documentation, launch and later original research. IKP v2 Table 15 leaves mini Params blank; its effective-capacity calibration is not a deployed count. Amity’s ~8-20B comparison range has no count source or method and is not adopted. No exact tensor census is required to accept a supported nominal disclosure.

active_parameters_b.note: Rechecked separately through October 27 exact-model active/activated-parameter searches and later original research/comparison tables. No mini-specific active count or defined active-count convention was found. Amity labels only Size; IKP models effective knowledge capacity and reports no mini active count. Qualitative mini branding, API prices and a presumed dense architecture do not establish active parameters.

architecture.note: No exact-mini architecture disclosure found in the reviewed model documentation, launch, later system card, or first-party training/interpretability searches. The GPT name and disclosures about GPT-4, GPT-4.1, nano or gpt-oss do not establish mini’s structure. Later self-report training research also names mini but does not establish its structure.

context_window.note: Exact published base-model context limit. The launch’s one-million wording is rounded; the separate 32,768 maximum output limit is not the context length.

modalities.note: Native model inputs are text and image and output is text. Retain PDF under the catalog’s supported API-file convention: PDFs become extracted text plus page images, not a separate learned modality. No native audio/video input or image output is claimed.

reasoning.note: Exact-mini documentation explicitly says it operates without a reasoning step. This field denotes dedicated reasoning-mode behavior, not an inability to solve reasoning tasks.

tool_call.note: Exact-mini model documentation explicitly lists function calling; the launch also publishes mini-specific function-calling evaluations.

description.value: GPT-4.1 mini accepts text and images and generates text, with a 1,047,576-token context window and function calling.
description.note: Replace vague price/speed and structured-extraction marketing language with directly documented input, output, context and function-calling facts.

patch.description: GPT-4.1 mini accepts text and images and generates text, with a 1,047,576-token context window and function calling.

sources.label: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity (v2)

patch.notes: The unpinned gpt-4.1-mini name documents gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 as its default snapshot, first released April 14, 2025. The October 27, 2026 review records announced API removal on January 14, 2027; no live endpoint request was made. PDF inputs become text and page images. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; effective-capacity estimates and unattributed comparison ranges do not establish nominal counts. Exact-mini architecture remains unverified.

summary: Fresh October 27 parameter re-audit retains total and active counts as undisclosed, with explicit null patches. Reopened exact OpenAI documentation, launch, GPT-5 system card and self-report training paper; added IKP v2 and the rejected Amity comparison range. No supported nominal count, active-count convention or named-base size inference was found. Preserve the other twelve field assessments, including corrected GPT-4.1 family, proprietary classification, documented capabilities and release/lifecycle distinction.
